provenanceNote: Starting hypotheses written from public provider documentation and community experience — not benchmarked claims. PromptLoop refines these through your feedback, in your browser.

fields.instruction_style: Plain, declarative instructions; over-emphatic scaffolding (ALL CAPS, 'CRITICAL:') backfires
fields.reasoning_trigger: Adaptive reasoning is built in; explicit triggers are rarely needed
fields.format_adherence: Very high — state the shape once and it holds across long outputs
fields.verbosity_bias: Calibrates length to the task; explicit caps still help for hard limits
fields.role_sensitivity: Concrete roles help; generic 'act as an expert' adds little
fields.context_placement: Strong long-context recall; objective up front is still best practice

house_rules.text: State each constraint once, plainly — repeated emphasis causes overtriggering
Give the goal, not the step-by-step procedure — it plans well on its own
Specify defaults for ambiguous cases, or it may ask instead of guessing

failure_modes: Asks a clarifying question on genuinely ambiguous asks instead of guessing
May decline dual-use or sensitive tasks that lack stated context
